name: 金山词霸
text:
#!name=金山词霸
#!author=queitstart pro
#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/dict-mobile\.iciba\.com\/interface\/index\.php\?.+(c=ad|collectFeedsAdShowCount|KSFeedsAdCardViewController)/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mobile-pic\.cache\.iciba\.com\/feeds_ad\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/service\.iciba\.com\/popo\/open\/screens\/v\d\?adjson/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/\w+?\.kingsoft-office-service\.com\/ad/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/.+?\.kingsoft-office-service\.com/i then reject(404)

[Rule]
DOMAIN, ad-stat.ksosoft.com,REJECT
DOMAIN, img.auction-ads.wpscdn.cn,REJECT
DOMAIN, counter.kingsoft.com,REJECT
DOMAIN, counter.ksosoft.com,REJECT
DOMAIN, minfo.wps.cn,REJECT
DOMAIN, mobad.ijinshan.com,REJECT
DOMAIN, ups.ksmobile.net,REJECT
DOMAIN, ws.ksmobile.net,REJECT

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% dict-mobile.iciba.com, mobile-pic.cache.iciba.com, service.iciba.com, *.kingsoft-office-service.com
